semanticObjective: Contrast rules-first programming with examples-first machine learning.
subject: Two stacked causal lanes feeding the same neutral computer.
primaryAction: The upper lane starts with a rule card; the lower lane condenses examples into a rule.
causalLink: Changing the order of rules and examples distinguishes traditional programming from learning.
primaryComposition: Two large horizontal lanes with one clear label and flow per lane.
styleRealization: Coral arrows for supplied rules and lime for inferred rules.
continuity: Carry cyan example cards from the lower lane into the cat board.
fallbackIntent: Hold two readable lanes labeled rules first and examples first.
